moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user begins flying. After a set time, the user stops flying and attacks. No other actions can be taken while flying. Most moves used by opponents will not hit the user while it is flying. If the user is hit by a sync move or max move while flying, it will stop flying.

moves.name: Mini Potion All
moves.description: Restores the HP of all allied sync pairs by approximately 20% of their maximum HP.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: Lowers the target’s Speed by 1 stat rank.

moves.name: How Are Ya?
moves.description: Raises the Attack and Speed of all allied sync pairs by 4 stat ranks.

passives.name: Ground Teamwork
passives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs by 10%. Reduces attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 10%. The more allied sync pairs with the Ground theme you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by 5% and reduces damage by 2%. The maximum power-up is 20%, and the maximum damage reduction is 14%.)

passives.name: Ridicure 1
passives.description: Has a chance (10%) of restoring the user’s HP by approximately 20% of its maximum HP when an opponent’s attack move targeting the user misses.

passives.name: Quick Combo 3

passives.name: Natural Remedy
passives.description: Removes all status conditions from the user the first time it is inflicted by any status condition each battle.
